entries.title: II Timothy 3:1
segments: ¶But this know, that in [the] last days difficult times shall be there;

entries.title: II Timothy 3:2
segments: for men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, evil speakers, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, profane,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:3
segments: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, of unsubdued passions, savage, having no love for what is good,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:4
segments: traitors, headlong, of vain pretensions, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;

entries.title: II Timothy 3:5
segments: having a form of piety but denying the power of it: and from these turn away.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:6
segments: For of these are they who are getting into houses, and leading captive silly women, laden with sins, led by various lusts,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:7
segments: always learning, and never able to come to [the] knowledge of [the] truth.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:8
segments: Now in the same manner in which Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, thus these also withstand the truth; men corrupted in mind, found worthless as regards the faith.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:9
segments: But they shall not advance farther; for their folly shall be completely manifest to all, as that of those also became.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:10
segments: ¶But *thou* hast been thoroughly acquainted with my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, endurance,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:11
segments: persecutions, sufferings: what [sufferings] happened to me in Antioch, in Iconium, in Lystra; what persecutions I endured; and the Lord delivered me out of all.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:12
segments: And all indeed who desire to live piously in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:13
segments: But wicked men and juggling impostors shall advance in evil, leading and being led astray.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:14
segments: But *thou*, abide in those things which thou hast learned, and [of which] thou hast been fully persuaded, knowing of whom thou hast learned [them];

entries.title: II Timothy 3:15
segments: and that from a child thou hast known the sacred letters, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation, through faith which [is] in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:16
segments: Every scripture [is] divinely inspired, and profitable for teaching, for conviction, for correction, for instruction in righteousness;

entries.title: II Timothy 3:17
segments: that the man of God may be complete, fully fitted to every good work.
